promotion_failures: Per-task-class and per-surface sample floors are not met.
Most real surface smokes have one sample per route, so p95 and variance are not established.
Expected total cost, including retries and verification, is not measured consistently across surfaces.
The Kanban integration smoke validates persistence and invalidation but does not launch a model worker.
The current installed Hermes CLI rejects cc-dynamic-workflow ephemeral-session registration flags; explicit session deletion was required for cleanup.
The one-shot six-case profile is a prefilter and is not transport-equivalent to delegated, Kanban, Codex, OMP, or workflow surfaces.
conclusion: The shared decision interface and exact-route adapters are viable staged candidates, but neither Luna-high nor Sol-low has enough current task-and-surface evidence for a schema-v2 admitted policy. Keep the incumbent unchanged and fail closed for evidence-selected routing until the missing samples, p95, cost, and lifecycle evidence exist.
rollback: Remove the staged adapter bundle and Hermes worktree; the incumbent policy and existing persisted runs are unchanged.
